title: The Foundry Shift
place: an aluminum foundry at shift change
source: Goran runs the night pour at an aluminum foundry. Teo reports that the crucible tag for pot seven is cracked and unreadable. Goran thinks Teo dropped it, but he did not see it happen. Company rule says a cracked tag must be re-stamped by the shift metallurgist before the pour. The metallurgist is on the floor but has not been reached. A floor fan rattles against its guard. The pour is held at the furnace mouth.
required: A cracked crucible tag must be re-stamped by the shift metallurgist before the pour. The metallurgist is the only person authorized to re-stamp it. The tag for pot seven is cracked and unreadable. The pour of pot seven has not begun. The night shift is responsible for the pour.
belief: Goran suspects Teo dropped the tag; he did not see it happen and Teo has not admitted it.
optional: The pour is held at the furnace mouth while the shift waits for the metallurgist.
incidental: A floor fan rattles against its bent guard.
update: Accepted revision: the metallurgist arrives and re-stamps the tag for pot seven. The pour then begins, and the cracked tag is kept in the shift log.
new_state: The tag for pot seven has been re-stamped; the pour is now permitted.
forbidden: Teo admits he deliberately cracked the tag.
revision:
Goran held up the tag.
The furnace door groaned open.

title: The Cannery Line
place: a salmon cannery on the night line
source: Marta supervises the night line at a cannery. Quin stops the conveyor after a bent guide rail sends cans onto the floor. Marta believes Quin bumped the rail with a pallet jack, but the security camera view is fogged. Plant policy requires a maintenance sign-off before the line restarts. The maintenance office is empty and the supervisor is at lunch. A radio plays a call-in show above the noise. The line stays stopped while cans pile in the bin.
required: The line cannot restart without a maintenance sign-off. The guide rail is bent. The conveyor has stopped. Cans are collecting in the bin. The maintenance sign-off is still missing.
belief: Marta suspects Quin bumped the rail with a pallet jack; the camera view is fogged and he denies it.
optional: A radio plays a call-in show above the noise of the plant.
incidental: The radio is tuned to a gardening phone-in.
update: Accepted revision: maintenance signs off on the repaired rail, and the line restarts. The cause of the bend remains undetermined.
new_state: The line has restarted; the guide rail's damage is still unexplained.
forbidden: Quin is fired for bending the guide rail.
revision:
Marta pressed the stop button.
A can rolled down the chute.
protected: A can rolled down the chute.

title: The Night Ambulance
source: Ife is a paramedic handing off a patient at the hospital bay. Basil, the receiving nurse, notices a blood tube labeled for the wrong patient. Ife believes the label was swapped during the drive, but the tube has not been retested. Protocol requires the lab to confirm a new sample before any transfusion. The patient's chart is still in transit with the transport team. A collapsed wheelchair sits by the doors. The handoff pauses at the threshold.
required: No transfusion may proceed until the lab confirms a new sample. The blood tube is labeled for the wrong patient. The patient's chart is still in transit. The handoff has reached the hospital bay. The lab has not retested the sample.
belief: Ife suspects the label was swapped in the ambulance; this is unconfirmed.
optional: A collapsed wheelchair sits by the doors.
incidental: The wheelchair is gray and folded.
update: Accepted revision: the lab rejects the mislabeled tube and accepts a fresh draw. The transfusion begins only after the fresh result.
new_state: A fresh sample is confirmed; the original mislabeled tube has been discarded.
forbidden: The patient receives blood from the mislabeled tube.
revision:
Ife handed over the cooler.
The bay doors slid shut.

title: The Clinic Triage
source: Wren volunteers at a rural clinic on a snowed-in evening. Odile brings in her father, who has a fever, and asks to jump the queue. Wren believes the father's condition is mild, but no temperature reading has been taken because the thermometer is broken. The clinic's only doctor is treating a stable patient and cannot step away. A kettle steams on the counter. The father waits with the other patients.
required: No temperature reading has been taken because the clinic thermometer is broken. The clinic's only doctor is occupied. Odile's father has a fever. The father has not been moved ahead of the queue. The clinic is snowed in.
belief: Wren believes the fever is mild; no reading supports this.
optional: A kettle steams on the counter.
incidental: The kettle is dented enamel.
update: Accepted revision: a working thermometer is found, and Odile's father is assessed and moved to a treatment room. The other patients keep their order.
new_state: The father has been assessed and moved to treatment; the queue order was otherwise unchanged.
forbidden: Odile's father collapses before he is seen.
revision:
Wren wiped the counter.
The kettle whistled low.

title: The Tenants' Hearing
source: Ravi clerks a tenants' hearing about a broken elevator. Delia presents a petition with enough signatures, but the stamp is from a different building's campaign. Delia believes the landlord is stalling, but no maintenance records have been entered. The hearing officer must rule on whether the petition is valid for this address. A ceiling tile has a water stain. The officer calls a short recess before ruling.
required: The petition bears a stamp from a different building's campaign. The hearing officer has not yet ruled on the petition's validity. No maintenance records have been entered. The hearing concerns a broken elevator. The hearing has been recessed.
belief: Delia believes the landlord is stalling; no maintenance records support this.
optional: A ceiling tile has a water stain.
incidental: The ceiling stain is dark brown.
update: Accepted revision: the officer rules the petition invalid for this address and allows Delia to refile with correct signatures. The elevator remains unrepaired.
new_state: The petition has been ruled invalid for this address; Delia may refile.
forbidden: The officer orders the elevator repaired immediately.
revision:
Ravi stacked the forms.
The recess clock started.

title: The Jury Backroom
source: Selma is a juror on a theft trial. Hob passes her a folded note that says a witness was paid, but he will not say who told him. Selma believes the note is a prank, though no one has checked its handwriting. The judge has instructed the jury not to consider outside evidence. A bailiff stands outside the door. The foreman calls for another vote before sending word.
required: The judge has instructed the jury not to consider outside evidence. The note claims a witness was paid. Hob will not name his source. No one has examined the note's handwriting. The jury has not reached a verdict.
belief: Selma suspects the note is a prank; the handwriting is unchecked.
optional: A bailiff stands outside the door.
incidental: The note is folded twice.
update: Accepted revision: the foreman gives the note to the judge, who instructs the jury to disregard it and resume deliberation. No verdict has been reached.
new_state: The note is with the judge; the jury continues to deliberate without a verdict.
forbidden: The note is proven to be genuine.
revision:
Selma unfolded the paper.
A chair scraped in the hall.
protected: A chair scraped in the hall.

title: The Cargo Inspection
source: Nnamdi inspects containers at a dock. Vera flags a manifest that lists a refrigerated container as dry goods. Nnamdi thinks the error is clerical, but the seal number has not been checked. Port rules require a customs officer to approve any unsealing. The customs office opens at eight. A gantry crane idles overhead. The container waits on the quay.
required: Only a customs officer may approve unsealing the container. The manifest lists a refrigerated container as dry goods. The seal number has not been checked. The container is waiting on the quay. The customs office opens at eight.
belief: Nnamdi suspects a clerical error; the seal is unchecked.
optional: A gantry crane idles overhead.
incidental: The quay is wet from rain.
update: Accepted revision: the customs officer checks the seal and authorizes a partial inspection. The contents are not yet fully inventoried.
new_state: A partial inspection is authorized; the manifest discrepancy is unresolved.
forbidden: The container is found to hold contraband.
revision:
Nnamdi tapped the manifest.
The crane horn sounded twice.

title: The Tram Breakdown
source: Otto drives a tram that stalls between two stops during rush hour. Rue, a passenger, insists the fare machine owes her a refund and refuses to sit down. Otto believes a fuse blew, but the maintenance team has not arrived. City policy requires passengers to stay aboard until a tow is connected. A school group sings in the back car. The driver's radio crackles with competing instructions.
required: Passengers must stay aboard until a tow is connected. The fare machine is dead. The maintenance team has not arrived. The tram is stopped between two stations. The driver's radio is receiving instructions.
belief: Otto suspects a blown fuse; no inspection has confirmed it.
optional: A school group sings in the back car.
incidental: The school group sings a song about rivers.
update: Accepted revision: the maintenance team arrives and connects the tow. Passengers remain aboard until the tram reaches the depot.
new_state: The tram is being towed; passengers remain aboard.
forbidden: The fare machine is repaired and pays Rue her refund.
revision:
Otto keyed the radio.
The overhead lights flickered once.

title: The Seed Cooperative
source: Ilse manages a seed cooperative before spring planting. Peder brings an unlabeled sack he found in the loft and claims it holds the old barley variety. Ilse believes the sack is mislabeled feed grain, but no germination test has been run. The cooperative's rule is that only tested seed may be distributed. The agronomist visits on Thursday. A barn cat sleeps on a grain scale. The sack stays roped in the corner.
required: Only tested seed may be distributed. The sack is unlabeled. No germination test has been run. The agronomist visits on Thursday. The sack remains roped in the corner.
belief: Peder claims the sack holds the old barley variety; this is untested.
optional: A barn cat sleeps on a grain scale.
incidental: The cat is a tabby.
update: Accepted revision: the agronomist tests a sample on Thursday and identifies it as feed grain. It is not distributed.
new_state: The sack is identified as feed grain; it remains undistributed.
forbidden: The sack is distributed as seed before testing.
revision:
Ilse hefted the sack.
Straw dust rose in the lamplight.
protected: Straw dust rose in the lamplight.

title: The Veterinary Rounds
source: Cass is a large-animal vet called to a dairy farm at night. Emory, the farmhand, says the heifer is calving but the ear tag is twisted and unreadable, so he cannot confirm her records. Cass believes the heifer is the one due next week, not tonight, but the herd list is in the farmhouse. Farm protocol requires the owner's consent before any surgery. The owner is in the far field. A kerosene lamp gutters on a post. The heifer stands in the pen.
required: The owner's consent is required before any surgery. The ear tag is twisted and unreadable. The herd list is in the farmhouse. The heifer is standing in the pen. The heifer has not been identified by record.
belief: Cass believes the heifer is the one due next week; the herd list is unchecked.
optional: A kerosene lamp gutters on a post.
incidental: The lamp glass is cracked.
update: Accepted revision: the owner arrives and consents, and the heifer is examined. She is not yet in active labor.
new_state: Consent is given and the heifer is examined; labor has not begun.
forbidden: The heifer dies during the night.
revision:
Cass pulled on a glove.
The barn door banged in the wind.
protected: The barn door banged in the wind.

title: The Storm Lab
place: a weather research station on a ridge
source: Junia runs instruments at a weather research station. Elias reports a cracked anemometer cup after a gust, and the wind-speed record for the hour is now suspect. Junia believes the cup was cracked before the gust, but the maintenance log has not been checked. Protocol requires a second instrument to confirm any reading used in the forecast. The backup mast is iced over. A kettle boils on a camp stove. The reading stays flagged, not published.
required: A second instrument must confirm any reading used in the forecast. The anemometer cup is cracked. The wind-speed record for the hour is flagged. The backup mast is iced over. The reading has not been published.
belief: Junia suspects the cup was cracked before the gust; the log is unchecked.
optional: A kettle boils on a camp stove.
incidental: The kettle is chipped enamel.
update: Accepted revision: the backup mast clears and confirms the reading within tolerance. The flagged record is restored.
new_state: The reading is confirmed by the backup instrument and published.
forbidden: The cracked cup is the only cause of a record storm.
revision:
Junia logged the hour.
The ridge wind rose again.

title: The Materials Bench
source: Priya tests an alloy sample for a bridge contract. Sandor reports the sample is warped and asks her to pass it anyway because the deadline is Friday. Priya believes the warp came from the oven, but the oven chart has not been read. Test standards require a second sample before any pass result is recorded. A clipboard of run numbers hangs on the wall. The sample waits under the press.
required: A second sample is required before recording a pass result. The alloy sample is warped. The oven chart has not been read. The bridge contract deadline is Friday. The sample has not passed.
belief: Priya suspects the oven caused the warp; the chart is unchecked.
optional: A clipboard of run numbers hangs on the wall.
incidental: The clipboard has a red clip.
update: Accepted revision: the oven chart is read and a second sample is tested; it meets tolerance and is recorded.
new_state: A second sample has passed; the warped sample's cause remains uncertain.
forbidden: Priya records the warped sample as a pass.
revision:
Priya set the sample down.
The press hummed to a stop.
protected: The press hummed to a stop.

title: The Fish Market
source: Kofi sells from a stall at a fish market. Mira disputes the weight of her order and says his scale is off. Kofi believes she is angling for a discount, but the inspector has not tested the scale today. Market rules require the inspector's seal on every scale before trading. The inspector's booth is shuttered. Ice melts in a blue tub. The next customer waits with an empty basket.
required: Every scale needs the inspector's seal before trading. Mira disputes the weight of her order. The scale has not been tested today. The inspector's booth is shuttered. The next customer is waiting.
belief: Kofi suspects Mira wants a discount; this is unproven.
optional: Ice melts in a blue tub.
incidental: The waiting customer carries a wicker basket.
update: Accepted revision: the inspector opens and seals the scale; the reweighed order matches Mira's claim. Kofi refunds the difference.
new_state: The scale is sealed and the order reweighed; a refund is issued.
forbidden: Kofi is found to have rigged the scale.
revision:
Kofi tipped the scale pan.
A gull landed on the ice tub.
protected: A gull landed on the ice tub.

title: The Hardware Counter
source: Bea mixes paint at a hardware store. Curtis returns a can of paint that does not match the sample chip he kept. Bea believes he used a different primer, but the primer can has been thrown away. Store policy requires a manager's approval before remixing for free. The manager is doing inventory in the yard. A flyer for a spring sale curls on the counter. Curtis holds his sample chip under the light.
required: A manager must approve any free remix. The paint does not match Curtis's sample chip. The primer can has been discarded. The manager is doing inventory in the yard. The paint has not been remixed.
belief: Bea suspects Curtis used a different primer; the can is gone.
optional: A spring sale flyer curls on the counter.
incidental: The flyer advertises lawn seed.
update: Accepted revision: the manager approves one free remix, and the new can matches the chip. Curtis keeps the mismatched can.
new_state: A matching can has been mixed; the mismatched can remains with Curtis.
forbidden: The mismatch is proven to be Bea's mixing error.
revision:
Bea stirred the can.
The paint smell filled the aisle.
protected: The paint smell filled the aisle.

title: The Night Class
object: a graded exam with a smudged grade
source: Aurelio teaches a night math class. Nkechi asks him to raise her grade on an exam where the score is smudged and unreadable. Aurelio believes the smudge covers a failing mark, but the answer sheet shows correct work for the relevant problem. Department policy requires a second reader before any grade is changed. The department head is at a conference. A projector hums in the dark. The exam sits on the desk between them.
required: A second reader must review before any grade is changed. The exam score is smudged. The answer sheet shows correct work for the relevant problem. The department head is at a conference. Nkechi's grade has not been changed.
belief: Aurelio suspects the smudge covers a failing mark; this is unconfirmed.
optional: A projector hums in the dark.
incidental: The projector remote is missing its battery cover.
update: Accepted revision: a colleague acts as second reader and confirms the correct work; Nkechi's grade is raised. The department head is informed by email.
new_state: A second reader has confirmed the work and the grade is raised.
forbidden: Nkechi is accused of altering the exam.
revision:
Aurelio slid the exam across.
The hallway bell rang once.

title: The School Play Audition
source: Dmitri directs a school play. Saoirse, a parent, insists her son should read for the lead and has marked up a script with his name. Dmitri believes the boy is better suited to a smaller role, but no callback list has been posted. School policy requires a second staff member at every audition. The music teacher is tuning the piano, not watching. A prop crown sits on the piano. The audition line waits behind the curtain.
required: A second staff member must be present at every audition. Saoirse has marked a script with her son's name. No callback list has been posted. The music teacher is not observing the auditions. The audition line is waiting behind the curtain.
belief: Dmitri believes the boy suits a smaller role; no callbacks are posted.
optional: A prop crown sits on the piano.
incidental: The crown is tinsel-covered.
update: Accepted revision: a second staff member joins the auditions, and a callback list is posted after all readings. Saoirse's son is called back for two roles.
new_state: Auditions are properly staffed and a callback list is posted.
forbidden: Saoirse's son is given the lead on the spot.
revision:
Dmitri raised a hand.
The curtain rope creaked overhead.

title: The Boxing Gym
place: a boxing gym before a weigh-in
source: Tariq trains a fighter at a boxing gym. Vonda, the cutman, finds a cracked hand wrap in the fighter's bag and wants the bout postponed. Tariq believes the wrap was damaged after the last sparring session, but the equipment log has not been checked. Commission rules require a licensed inspector to approve all hand wraps at the weigh-in. The inspector is stuck in traffic. A skipping rope lies tangled by the ring. The fighter warms up on the pads.
required: A licensed inspector must approve all hand wraps at the weigh-in. The hand wrap is cracked. The equipment log has not been checked. The inspector is stuck in traffic. The bout has not been called off.
belief: Tariq suspects the wrap was damaged after sparring; the log is unchecked.
optional: A skipping rope lies tangled by the ring.
incidental: The skipping rope is red.
update: Accepted revision: the inspector arrives and approves new wraps; the bout proceeds on schedule. The cracked wrap is logged.
new_state: New wraps are approved and the bout proceeds; the cracked wrap is logged.
forbidden: The fighter is disqualified for the cracked wrap.
revision:
Tariq taped the wrist.
The ring bell clanged once.

title: The Orchestra Rehearsal
source: Halina leads a chamber orchestra rehearsal before a broadcast. Bruno, the principal clarinetist, says his reed is warped and asks to switch the program order. Halina believes the reed changed overnight because of the hall's new heating, but the humidity log has not been read. The broadcast contract requires the program order to be filed an hour before air. The stage manager is on the phone. A music stand leans in the wings. The players tune while they argue.
required: The program order must be filed an hour before broadcast. Bruno's clarinet reed is warped. The humidity log has not been read. The players are already tuning. The program order has not been changed.
belief: Halina suspects the heating warped the reed; the log is unchecked.
optional: A music stand leans in the wings.
incidental: The stand holds a penciled score.
update: Accepted revision: the humidity log is read and the program order is filed unchanged; Bruno switches reeds and the rehearsal continues.
new_state: The program order stands; the reed has been replaced and rehearsal continues.
forbidden: The broadcast is cancelled because of the reed.
revision:
Halina raised the baton.
A tuning note hung in the hall.
protected: A tuning note hung in the hall.

title: The Kitchen Move
source: Rosa and Gil pack up their mother's apartment before she moves to assisted living. Gil wants to keep a chipped mixing bowl that he says was their grandmother's. Rosa believes the bowl came from a yard sale, but no one has asked their mother. Their mother's instruction is that nothing leaves the apartment until the inventory is signed. The notary comes tomorrow. A radio plays a baseball game in the kitchen. The bowl sits on the counter with a price sticker.
required: Nothing may leave the apartment until the inventory is signed. The mixing bowl has a price sticker. The notary comes tomorrow. The bowl's origin has not been confirmed. The apartment is being packed.
belief: Gil says the bowl was their grandmother's; Rosa thinks it came from a yard sale.
optional: A radio plays a baseball game in the kitchen.
incidental: The radio is tuned to a night game.
update: Accepted revision: their mother confirms the bowl came from a yard sale, and the signed inventory permits Gil to keep it. The move proceeds.
new_state: The bowl's origin is settled and the inventory is signed; Gil keeps the bowl.
forbidden: Rosa throws the bowl away without asking.
revision:
Rosa wrapped a plate.
A floorboard creaked in the hall.
protected: A floorboard creaked in the hall.

title: The Birthday Setup
source: Eunice hosts her father's birthday in the backyard. Fonso, her brother, arrives late with a cake and blames the collapsed cake stand on a bent leg. Eunice believes he dropped the cake in the car, but the box shows no crumbs. Their father has asked that no one mention his retirement. A neighbor's sprinkler hisses at the fence. The cake is salvaged on a plate.
required: No one may mention their father's retirement. The cake stand has a bent leg. Fonso arrived late with the cake. The cake box shows no crumbs. The cake has been moved to a plate.
belief: Eunice suspects Fonso dropped the cake; the box is clean.
optional: A neighbor's sprinkler hisses at the fence.
incidental: The sprinkler waters a hedge.
update: Accepted revision: Fonso admits he dropped the cake, and the party continues without mentioning the retirement. Their father makes a short toast.
new_state: The cake's fall is acknowledged; the retirement remains unmentioned.
forbidden: A guest toasts their father's retirement.
revision:
Eunice set out the plates.
The screen door slapped shut.

title: The Remote Standup
source: Priyanka runs a daily video standup for a distributed team. Dov joins with his microphone muted and types that the production database was rolled back overnight. Priyanka believes a scheduled migration caused it, but no deploy log has been opened. Team policy requires an incident ticket before any rollback is reversed. The on-call engineer is offline. A coffee mug overlaps the corner of Dov's camera. The call continues with the incident unresolved.
required: An incident ticket is required before any rollback is reversed. Dov's microphone is muted. Dov reports the production database was rolled back. The deploy log has not been opened. The on-call engineer is offline.
belief: Priyanka suspects a scheduled migration; the deploy log is unchecked.
optional: A coffee mug overlaps the corner of Dov's camera.
incidental: The mug is from a conference.
update: Accepted revision: the on-call engineer comes online and opens an incident ticket; the rollback is investigated but not reversed.
new_state: An incident ticket exists and the rollback is under investigation.
forbidden: The rollback is reversed during the standup.
revision:
Priyanka shared her screen.
The call timer kept counting.

title: The Group Chat
source: Lena moderates a neighborhood message board. Marcus reports that a post about a lost dog was deleted, and he suspects another moderator removed it. Lena believes the original poster deleted it, but the moderation log has not been checked. Board rules require two moderators to approve any permanent ban. A storm warning banner scrolls across the top. The thread fills with replies. The missing-dog search continues offline.
required: Two moderators must approve any permanent ban. A post about a lost dog was deleted. The moderation log has not been checked. A storm warning banner is scrolling. The missing dog has not been found.
belief: Lena suspects the original poster deleted it; the log is unchecked.
optional: The thread fills with replies.
incidental: The lost dog is a beagle.
update: Accepted revision: the moderation log is checked and shows the original poster deleted the post. No ban is issued and the thread is closed.
new_state: The deletion is explained; no ban is issued and the thread is closed.
forbidden: Marcus is banned for deleting the post.
revision:
Lena opened the log.
A notification chimed twice.

title: The Harvest Service
source: Mirembe prepares a harvest service in a village meeting house. Silas finds the processional candle cracked and wants to use it anyway to keep the schedule. Mirembe believes the crack came from the cold store, but the sexton has not inspected it. The rite requires the candle to be lit only from the central flame. The visiting elder arrives at noon. A woven mat lies before the door. The procession has not begun.
required: The processional candle must be lit only from the central flame. The processional candle is cracked. The sexton has not inspected the candle. The visiting elder arrives at noon. The procession has not begun.
belief: Mirembe suspects the cold store cracked the wax; the sexton has not inspected it.
optional: A woven mat lies before the door.
incidental: The mat is dyed with red patterns.
update: Accepted revision: the sexton replaces the cracked candle, and the procession begins at noon with the central flame. The old candle is set aside.
new_state: A sound candle is used and the procession has begun.
forbidden: The service is cancelled because of the cracked candle.
revision:
Mirembe lifted the taper.
A bell tolled in the yard.
protected: A bell tolled in the yard.

title: The Memorial Walk
source: Thandi organizes a hillside memorial walk for a mining disaster. Amos, a volunteer, finds the lead banner torn and wants to carry it anyway so the walk is not delayed. Thandi believes the wind tore it overnight, but the storage shed has not been checked. The organizers' rule is that no damaged banner may lead the procession. A bus of survivors is due at ten. Wildflowers grow along the path. The walkers gather at the gate.
required: No damaged banner may lead the procession. The lead banner is torn. The storage shed has not been checked. A bus of survivors is due at ten. The walkers have gathered at the gate.
belief: Thandi suspects the wind tore the banner; the shed is unchecked.
optional: Wildflowers grow along the path.
incidental: The flowers are white and yellow.
update: Accepted revision: the shed is checked and a spare banner is found; the walk begins at ten led by the spare. The torn banner is stored.
new_state: The walk proceeds behind a spare banner; the torn banner is stored.
forbidden: The walk is called off because of the torn banner.
revision:
Thandi unfolded the banner.
The hillside path lay empty.
